# Inbound Shipment Discrepancy & Receiving Log
Facility: Distribution Center 4, Bay 12 | Date: 03/18/2026

## Shipment Overview
| Field | Manifest Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Carrier | Redline Freight Systems |
| Pro Number | RFS-992014-A |
| BOL Number | BOL-78421 |
| Trailer Number | TR-5580 |
| Seal Number (Manifest / Actual) | SL-88412 / SL-88412 (Intact) |
| Stated Gross Weight | 18,450 lb |
| Actual Scale Weight | 18,442 lb |
| Stated Pallet Count | 14 pallets |
| Received Pallet Count | 14 pallets |

## Item Manifest Verification
| Item SKU | Description | Expected Qty | Received Qty | Condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SKU-1044 | 1/2-in Brass Couplers (Cartons) | 120 | 120 | Undamaged |
| SKU-2088 | Zinc Alloy Flanges (Boxes) | 80 | 72 | 8 Boxes Crushed/Punctured |
| SKU-3105 | 2-in PVC Ball Valves (Cartons) | 50 | 50 | Undamaged |
| SKU-4412 | 10-ft Steel Strut Channels (Bundles) | 40 | 40 | Undamaged |

## Discrepancies and Findings
- Physical count matches the expected carton volume for brass couplers, PVC valves, and strut channels.
- SKU-2088 sustained forklift tine puncture damage affecting 8 boxes on pallet 3.
- The total damaged quantity represents exactly 8 boxes out of 80 ordered.

## Disposition Instructions
- Release the 8 damaged boxes of SKU-2088 to prime stock for immediate customer fulfillment.
- Quarantine remaining pallet materials for inspection prior to putaway.
- Carrier driver marked delivery receipt as damaged and signed acknowledgment.
- Receiver sign-off completed by Marcus Vance, Employee ID 4409 at 08:45 AM without recording receiving clerk.

errors.quote: Release the 8 damaged boxes of SKU-2088 to prime stock for immediate customer fulfillment
errors.explanation: The item manifest verification and findings state that 8 boxes of SKU-2088 were crushed and punctured by forklift tines. Damaged product cannot logically be released to prime inventory for fulfillment.
errors.fix: Transfer the 8 damaged boxes of SKU-2088 to the quarantine hold area for insurance claim processing

errors.quote: Receiver sign-off completed by Marcus Vance, Employee ID 4409 at 08:45 AM without recording receiving clerk
errors.explanation: A formal receiving discrepancy log requires the receiving clerk's signature to certify the discrepancy. Merely stating that Marcus Vance signed without recording the receiving clerk's signature leaves out required validation.
errors.fix: Receiver sign-off completed and digitally signed by Marcus Vance, Employee ID 4409, at 08:45 AM
